id: title:dmarchuk:log the refusal code when a transactional email is rejected

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to transactional email delivery error classification and response payload enrichment.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 modifies the retrieval and assignment of the refusal code, potentially changing the exception raised or the classification of delivery failures. P1.F1.H2 adds this code to the response payload, aiding debugging. P1.F2.H1 adds a test utility. While the exact behavior depends on the missing dictionary and helper definitions, the implementation demonstrates a change
review.uncertainty: The exact compatibility and correctness implications cannot be fully assessed without the definition of PIPELINE_REFUSALS and the implementation of _refusal_code, as the chunk does not include them. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation and its potential impact, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of the PIPELINE_REFUSALS dictionary or the _refusal_code helper, so the exact refusal codes and their mapping are not visible. The hunk P1.F1.H1 shows a variable rename and a change in how the refusal code is passed, but without the definition, the exact behavior and potential compatibility or correctness implications are not fully assess.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H1 changes the retrieval of the refusal code. It no longer calls _refusal_code(response) or None, but instead assigns the result of _refusal_code(response) to refusal_code, then uses that variable to look up the refusal in PIPELINE_REFUSALS. This could change the behavior if _refusal_code returns None or if the lookup key changes, potentially affecting the error type
observations.posthog_connection: This could change the error classification and the exception raised when the CDP pipeline rejects a transactional email, potentially affecting delivery and error reporting for PostHog users.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H2 adds the refusal_code to the metrics payload. This could help with debugging and monitoring, allowing PostHog users to see the refusal code in the response.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help with debugging and monitoring, allowing PostHog users to see the refusal code in the response.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F2.H1 adds a test utility for capturing logs, which could help with debugging and monitoring, allowing PostHog users to see the refusal code in the response.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help with debugging and monitoring, allowing PostHog users to see the refusal code in the response.
